newsitem.title: USA: Public Service of North Carolina adopts plan.
newsitem.headline: Public Service of North Carolina adopts plan.

text.p: Public Service Co of North Carolina Inc said its board adopted a stockholder rights plan in which rights will be distributed as a dividend at the rate of one right for each share of common stock.

The company said the plan was not adopted in response to any effort to acquire control of PSNC. It is designed to deter coercive takeover tactics including the accumulation of shares in the open market or through private transactions and to prevent an acquiror from gaining control without offering a fair price to all of its stockholders.
Each right initially will entitle stockholders to buy one unit of a share of preferred stock for $55.00 per share.

The rights generally will be exercisable only if a person or group acquires beneficial ownership of 15 percent or more of the company's common stock or commences a tender or exchange offer upon consummation of which such person or group would beneficially own 15 percent or more of the company's common stock. The Rights will expire on April 9, 2007.
